query:
SELECT  ' [[Datei:item_' || regions_ores.ore || 'ore.png|zentriert|frameless|64x64px]]' AS Bild, 
  regions_ores.ore AS 'ore (engl.)',  
  '#Lang#journal#page_resources.' || regions_ores.ore AS 'Erz', 
  '#Lang#journal#page_resources.resources_' || regions_ores.ore || '.text1' AS Beschreibung, 
  region AS 'Region'
  FROM regions_ores  WHERE  regions_ores.ore NOT NULL 
   order by regions_ores.ore
